name: L10 PanoLab fresh target-way/item-disjoint active lexical panel V2
question: After rejecting V1 before materialization, can the unchanged metadata-only rule freeze four named active-view pairs while additionally excluding every V1 item found in prior pixel evidence?

selection_rule.v2_change: Add the two prior-evidence item IDs identified by the V1 audit to the exclusion set. Do not change pair eligibility, ranking, city round-robin, or panel size.
selection_rule.eligibility: Require a named target way unused by the prior four active episodes; both item IDs absent from that source, its local image directory, and the V1 audit exclusion set; reciprocal same-sequence provider adjacency; 3-15 metre motion; metadata geometry transition from target/other-building occluded to DIRECT; 4-40 metre after-frame entrance range; and both items passing the unchanged strict orientation gate.
selection_rule.within_target_way: Choose the pair by ascending significant target-name token count, after entrance distance, sequence ID, start item ID, after item ID.
selection_rule.panel: Group the chosen target-way pairs by source city; within city sort by significant target-name token count, after entrance distance, target-way ID and sequence ID; select round-robin over city name order while requiring unique sequence IDs until four episodes are frozen.
forbidden_inputs: selected full, SD, thumbnail, or tile pixels
human portal or sign visibility judgment

materialization.download_rule: Only after the V2 selection output exists; refuse existing destination or stale temporary; verify exact full-sensor 2:1 dimensions; record URL, bytes and SHA-256.

claim_boundary.allowed: A target-way-, item-, and prior-active-sequence-disjoint Development roster selected without viewing the selected pixels or model outputs, after excluding the prior-evidence items found by the V1 audit.
not_allowed: pixel portal visibility or lexical readability
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
